title: Fan location.
officialText:
Fans exhausting noxious, toxic, hot vapor or grease-laden air shall be located as close to the terminus as practicable,
at the roof or within a mechanical equipment room, immediately below the roof.
Exception: Where the fan is listed or approved for such an application.
SECTION MC 504
CLOTHES DRYER EXHAUST
